synopsis: Chapter 11 and the glossary consistently identify Project Chrono as open-source software under BSD-3; the glossary also describes it as free [f8492, f9121, f15907]. Chapter 11 explicitly extends BSD-3 coverage to Chrono::Vehicle and Chrono::Sensor [f8492, f9076]. The glossary classifies BSD-3 as permissive and says companies may use, modify and redistribute covered software, including in commercial products, provided the original copyright notice is retained [f15924, f15925]. It also states that companies need not publish their own changes [f15927].
